composure.line: I'm trying hard to keep my composure
stanza: I'm trying hard to keep my composure
We cannot wait around till it happens

composure.line: Wallflower is waiting, she hides behind composure
stanza: Wallflower is waiting, she hides behind composure
She'd love to dance and prays that no one asks her
Then she steals a glance at lovers while her fingers tease her hair
She marvels at the confidence of those who hide their fear
Then her eyes are closed as she rides away with a foreign legionnaire
And my shoulders had to shrug as I crawled beneath the rug
